volumeOneStructure.rule: Volume one opens in 2026 Taiwan and follows cause-and-effect scene flow. Do not open with exposition lists, world lectures, or the old 灰關 market draft.
volumeOneStructure.crossingPlacement: Crossing happens inside or immediately after the Taiwan coastal survival arc, not before the story begins.

stageQualities: nearby Japanese-era northern thermal power infrastructure echoes
openingSetting.historicalEcho: 日治時期北部火力發電相關建設遺留；二戰末期倉促撤離後，可見廢墟與未知遺留並存。

weatherContext.storyUse: Realistic pressure that narrows escape options and justifies loss of phone signal, darkening sky, and flooded return routes.

sceneFlow.detail: 陸塵行 checks tide tables and believes he still has about two hours.
On the sea erosion platform he discovers strange remains or structures that may connect to exposed Japanese-era infrastructure or something older hidden beneath it.
He studies the find too long because curiosity overrides caution.
Sea level rises faster than expected; the route he used to enter is no longer passable.
Rocks that were walkable on the way in are now submerged by waves.
Bavi's outer circulation intensifies; wind and surf worsen.
Daylight collapses quickly under weather pressure.
Phone has no service; modern help is unavailable.
陸塵行 and 愛醬 retreat toward an abandoned hillside structure tied to the old northern power-plant legacy as the only plausible shelter.

interiorAndCrossingArc.rule: Beats 10-18 are mandatory slow progression inside the ruin. Crossing time is ambiguous even to 陸塵行 and 愛醬.
interiorAndCrossingArc.notAllowed: Single-beat immediate displacement or early fantasy world reveal.

realismBasis: Intertidal zones can become impassable during rising tide plus strengthened wind and swell. This is ordinary coastal danger, not fantasy logic.
